source: Author's STOP 3 continuation message, 2026-09-13; requested verbatim readiness fields
timezone_evidence: All 20 validation repositories were captured completely. Against hourly GH Archive WatchEvents for 2024, binned three ways, America/Los_Angeles with daylight saving has the lowest mean absolute daily difference for 20 of 20 repositories against UTC and 18 of 20 against fixed UTC-8. The five small repositories agree exactly on 98 to 99.7 percent of days under Los Angeles; the large repositories' lower exact agreement reflects their volume, not day boundaries. The four repositories created between 01:00 and 05:00 UTC show first-day stars on the prior nominal date, as Los Angeles binning predicts. Week timestamps are Sunday 00:00 UTC labels, not boundary evidence.
unstar_interpretation: The endpoint reports stars that still exist at retrieval, dated by when they were given: full-history totals equal current star counts for 19 of 20 repositories. Over 2024 the endpoint is below the archive for 17 of 20 repositories, by 5 to 27 percent for the large ones and within a few counts for the small ones, consistent with later unstars and removed accounts. The monthly ratio across 2024 shows no trend with star age. The study target is therefore the surviving-star daily history as retrieved in September 2026, not gross additions. Frame eligibility uses gross archive counts; targets use survivors. No correction is applied.
